description: Hochwasserrückhaltebecken und Talsperren bei Freiburg i. Br is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoportal.freiburg.de. The spatial data set contains the locations of flood retention basins and dams for the Dreisam and Rhein-Wiese-Leopoldskanal sub-processing areas (TBG). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Flood retention basins and dams near Freiburg i. Br" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hochwassergefahrenkarte, Hochwasserrisikokarte, Hochwasserrückhaltebecken, Freiburg im Breisgau, Überflutung, Überschwemmung. The listing shows 5 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2015-09-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
